description:
- New packages/i18n (no Solid dependency). en catalog is the source of truth (`as const`); `Messages` type derived from it; ja must satisfy that type so missing keys fail `pnpm typecheck`. Parameterized messages are functions (e.g. `speakerN: (n: number) => ...`).
- Locale resolution: `uiLanguage: "system" | "en" | "ja"`; "system" walks navigator.languages (and the host locale if the spike finds one) and falls back to en.
- Formatters bound to the resolved locale: date/time, relative "Today", durations, numbers, byte sizes.
- Solid wrapper in apps/even-hub (context or signal) so switching language re-renders without reload; set <html lang> to the active locale.
- Settings: add uiLanguage with a migrateSettings step and tests; Settings view gets a "Display language" picker (English / 日本語 / System) shown in each language's own name.
- Tests: resolution/fallback, catalog parity (runtime check too, for keys added to en but stubbed in ja), formatter output for en and ja.
Consider @solid-primitives/i18n only if it works with solid-js 2.0 rc; otherwise keep the in-house typed catalog.
title: i18n foundation: @irl/i18n package, typed en/ja catalogs, uiLanguage setting
